title_en: Kolibri: A Sovereign European Model on the Pareto Frontier
title_zh: Kolibri：位于帕累托前沿的主权欧洲模型
summary_en: Kolibri is an English-German mixture-of-experts transformer with 78.1B total parameters and 3.46B active parameters per token, released as open weights under Apache 2.0. It was trained on 24T tokens with over 20% German data by bytes, including more than 2T curated and synthetic German tokens. Post-training combines supervised fine-tuning with reinforcement learning on over 1.2M internally curated tasks covering reasoning, tool use, instruction following, code, and retrieval. Activating 4.4% of parameters per token, Kolibri lies on the Pareto frontier of quality and serving cost among open models evaluated in English and German.
summary_zh: Kolibri 是一个英德双语混合专家（MoE）Transformer 模型，总参数 78.1B，每 token 激活参数 3.46B，以 Apache 2.0 许可证开源。模型在 24T token 上训练，其中德语数据按字节计占比超过 20%，包括超过 2T 的自建管道从网络整理及合成的德语 token。后训练结合了监督微调与在超过 120 万个内部整理任务上的强化学习，任务涵盖推理、工具使用、指令遵循、代码和检索。该模型每 token 激活 4.4% 的参数，在报告评估的开源模型中，于英语和德语的质量与服务成本帕累托前沿上占据位置。
content_en:
This report introduces Kolibri, an English-German mixture-of-experts transformer with 78.1B total parameters and 3.46B active parameters per token, released as open weights under the Apache 2.0 licence. We built Kolibri for sovereign and specialised deployment, with a particular focus on German and on regulated domains such as public administration, industry, and aerospace. To support these settings, we control the full model-development process, including data, architecture, training infrastructure, post-training, and evaluation.
  We train Kolibri on 24T tokens across pre-training, mid-training, and long-context extension, with German accounting for more than 20% of the data mix by bytes. To reach this share, we complement German datasets with more than 2T German tokens that we curate from the web with our own pipeline and generate synthetically. Post-training combines supervised fine-tuning on curated German and English data with reinforcement learning on more than 1.2M internally curated tasks, which cover reasoning, tool use, instruction following, code, and retrieval. The model activates 4.4% of its parameters per token, and among the open models evaluated in this report, it lies on the Pareto frontier of quality and serving cost in English and German.

本报告介绍 Kolibri，这是一个英语-德语混合专家 transformer，总参数 78.1B，每 token 激活参数 3.46B，以 Apache 2.0 许可证开放权重发布。我们构建 Kolibri 是为了主权和专业化部署，特别关注德语以及公共管理、工业和航空航天等受监管领域。为支持这些场景，我们控制完整的模型开发流程，包括数据、架构、训练基础设施、后训练和评估。
  我们在 24T token 上训练 Kolibri，涵盖预训练、中期训练和长上下文扩展，其中德语按字节计算占数据混合的 20% 以上。为达到这一比例，我们用自有流水线从网络整理并合成生成了超过 2T 德语 token，以补充德语数据集。后训练结合了在精选德语和英语数据上的监督微调，以及在超过 1.2M 个内部整理任务上的强化学习，这些任务涵盖推理、工具使用、指令遵循、代码和检索。该模型每 token 激活其参数的 4.4%，在本报告评估的开放模型中，它在英语和德语的质量与服务成本帕累托前沿上。
